description: Source code implementing a file descriptor buffer management system with functions for adding, retrieving, removing, and reference counting file descriptor buffers, guarded by mutexes, and conditionally compiled with FD_PASSING_EXPERIMENTAL.

methods.name: FD_VECTOR_Close
methods.description: Closes and frees a buffer of file descriptors.

methods.name: FD_VECTOR_New_Key
methods.description: Generates a new unique key for file descriptor buffer mapping.

methods.name: FD_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds a file descriptor buffer to the global map under a specified key.

methods.name: FD_VECTOR_Get
methods.description: Retrieves a file descriptor buffer and its count by key.

methods.name: FD_VECTOR_Remove
methods.description: Removes a file descriptor buffer from the global map by key.

methods.name: FD_VECTOR_IncRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for a buffer entry.

methods.name: FD_VECTOR_DecRef
methods.description: Decrements the reference count for a buffer entry.
